speakLocalProviderCardDesc: On-device Kokoro voice that reads assistant answers aloud. Nothing leaves your machine.
speakEnabledDesc: Adds a Speak button under each answer that reads it aloud with the selected voice.
speakEnglishOnlyNote: Only the English voices ship: the bundled phonemizer carries English pronunciation data alone.
speakAccentDesc: Filters the voice list. The accent follows the voice you pick.
speakVoiceDesc: Each voice is a 510 KB style file, downloaded the first time you use it.
speakSpeedDesc: Playback rate handed to the model, from 0.50x to 2.00x.
speakPreviewDesc: Speaks this line with the current voice and speed.
speakModelCardDesc: Weights are downloaded on demand and verified by SHA-256 before use.
speakDownloadSourceDesc: Mirror used for model weights and voice files.
speakModelTierDesc: int8 is the portable default; fp16 is faster on Apple Silicon; fp32 is the reference export.
speakModelResourceHint: About {{memory}} of memory, {{threads}} CPU threads. License {{license}}.
speakAutoDownloadDesc: When Speak is used before the weights exist, fetch them automatically and show progress.
speakKeepTracksDesc: Save the audio for each answer, so speaking it again is instant and you can download the recording.
speakStoredTracksDesc: Kept under your Kun data directory as WAV files.
